result:
Round 492 is planned: it makes the Account "Change Password" window a proper modal dialog. Attempt 1 had already written every planning file and stopped just before the hand-off. In this attempt I only checked them; I re-planned nothing, did not re-run the backlog update (so no decision IDs are duplicated) and did not touch the app source. The store is clean at `e4e1d1c`, which is the published round-491 commit and the baseline for round 492.

**Round 491:** C passed it in the real browser with 0 bugs, and the gate published `e4e1d1c` to both remotes. B-R487-PROFILE-EDITOR-NARROW-OVERFLOW (the "Full Name" editor not fitting on narrow phones) is now done for the frontend; the real-backend check stays blocked in the cloud.

**Round 492 (`current-task.md`):** B-R488-PASSWORD-MODAL-DIALOG plus two related Mediums in the same file: the password fields and show/hide buttons have no names, and the error message is silent to screen readers. Only `app/routes/account.tsx` changes, plus tests and docs; no protected files are touched.
- **What changes:** the window gets a name, focus moves into it, Tab stays inside, Esc closes it, focus returns to the "Change password" button, and the error is announced.
- **Prepared fix:** a ready patch (`b-round-491/sketch-492.patch.txt`, sha `f530e0f3…`) that applies cleanly on `e4e1d1c`.
- **Evidence:**
  - On today's code, 48 browser checks fail; with the patch, all 54 pass.
  - All 20 deliberately broken versions are caught by the tests.
  - The full test suite passes on the patched copy: 294 files, 4,309 tests.
  - tech-lead approved the final version.
- **C's rows:** the browser checks at 1440, 1280 and 375 px, against a production build. The full suite and `npm run verify` are left to the gate, and a real password change is marked blocked because there is no backend in the cloud.

**New High for root:** B-R492-PASSWORD-CHANGE-NOT-IMPLEMENTED. Changing the password can never succeed today, because `updatePassword` in the protected `auth.ts` always throws "not yet implemented". It needs a .NET endpoint plus a change to `auth.ts`, or Saba's decision to send users to forgot-password until then. It doesn't block the loop, but it does block COMPLETE.

**Also for root:** two architecture checkpoint requests are still unanswered (ARCH-CHECKPOINT-ACCOUNT-PROFILE and ARCH-CHECKPOINT-ENTRANCE-LOADING), and none of them block the loop. ROOT-REQ-LOOP-WEBM-EVIDENCE is also still open.

**Decision (`b-next.json`): CONTINUE.** Many scoped items remain, so it is not COMPLETE, and round 492 needs no outside input, so it is not BLOCKED. After round 492 comes DPG-BUTTON-CLEANUP; a regression round is due on or after 2026-11-16, and RETRO at round 495.

The advisor was available and used: once after orientation in attempt 1, and once for this final check.
